name: EnerSys
old_description: Manufactures industrial batteries and energy storage systems.
about:
EnerSys is headquartered in Reading, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 1974. The company manufactures industrial batteries and energy storage systems for critical power applications.

EnerSys produces a range of power solutions including application-specific batteries, high-performance chargers, monitoring and fleet management systems, and integrated energy systems. The portfolio spans trusted brands such as Alpha, Bren-Tronics, NexSys, Odyssey, and Rebel. The company also provides maintenance, repair, training, and technical support services. Operations are global, with subsidiaries around the world.

The company serves industries including logistics and warehousing, communication networks, cable broadband, data centers, aerospace and defense, industrial power and utilities, transportation, medical, safety and security, and 5G infrastructure. Case studies highlight a food and beverage distributor using NexSys TPPL batteries for lift trucks, a telecommunications provider in Milan deploying DataSafe UPS batteries, and support for KEK in maintaining uninterrupted power supply.

EnerSys states its mission is delivering solutions rather than simply selling products, emphasizing a full turnkey power solution backed by global teams and diverse expertise. The company aims to help customers achieve their goals with world-class products and services.
